text.autoconfig.bpk.title: BPK Mod
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.sprintBackwar: If enabled, you could sprint even if you are backward
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.inertiaThresh:
Stops the player from moving when their momentum is deemed negligible
vanilla default: 0.003
BE doesn't have such mechanic, if you want to simulate BE, try 0.0001 or less
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.isBESneak.@To: Clears horizontal motion when sneaking against edges (BE mode)
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.ignoreCollide: Hitting a wall will not cancel sprint
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.oldCollisionO: Resolve collisions in the fixed Y->X->Z order (pre-1.14) instead of ordering X/Z by speed
